as_told.title: Skunk Works head of revolutionary technology believes in mind-over-matter

plain: Michels says that in 2024 he spoke with a man who had been head of revolutionary technology at Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret division for advanced aircraft. In another episode he adds that he thinks it is fine to say this because the man is on record believing in this kind of thing, meaning the power of mind over matter. Michels tells it from his own conversation, without naming the man, as a sign that people at the top of secret aerospace work take such ideas seriously.
